title: Tenant locality guardrails: pin-by-policy controls and audit snapshot generator
creator: Asha Menon
description: Add a tenant-facing set of controls and backend automation for pinning hosted API traffic to allowed regions, configurable retention policies, and a generated audit snapshot that packages evidence for compliance reviews.
background: Customers have asked for declarative ways to restrict where their API requests are processed and to produce ‘audit-ready’ evidence packages for regulators. Existing internal offerings are piecemeal: region hints are supported in routing but there is no tenant-level enforcement policy, no unified retention UI, and no one-click evidence snapshot that collects placements, logs, and retention config. This ticket consolidates the product UI, backend enforcement, and evidence export pipeline.
goals: Expose a tenant-level policy UI to declare allowed regions and fallback behavior
Enforce region pinning in the routing layer with audit logging and SLA-aware fallbacks
Surface retention rules for request-level payloads and derived artifacts (embeddings, logs) per tenant
Provide an automated evidence snapshot export that bundles placements, retention settings, access logs, and attestations in a signed archive for auditors
non_goals: Support for on-prem private deployments (handled by Private product) in this phase
Full encryption key rotation flow — will integrate with KMS workstreams separately
Automated legal review of evidence contents — product will provide raw snapshot only
user_stories: As a security admin, I can pin my tenant to a set of regions and choose hard-fail or soft-fail fallback behavior
As a platform engineer, I can see per-request placement decisions and why a fallback occurred
As a compliance officer, I can generate an evidence snapshot for a date range containing placement records, retention policy config, and access audit logs
As a PM, I can observe retention drift alerts when tenant traffic is routed outside declared regions
acceptance_criteria: UI: Tenant can create/update a Region Policy with allowed region list, precedence, and fallback mode (hard | soft)
API: /v1/tenants/{id}/region-policy returns policy and a change history feed
Enforcement: Requests routed for a pinned tenant respect policy; hard-fail returns 403 with reason; soft-fail routes with a warning header and logs event
Audit: Evidence snapshot endpoint produces a signed ZIP containing (manifest.json, placements.csv, retention-config.json, access-logs.csv, policy-change-log.csv)
Retention: Retention settings are applied to storage TTLs for request bodies, embeddings, and operational logs; retention overrides are recorded in change history
Metrics: Dashboard shows policy matches, fallbacks, enforcement errors, and snapshot exports; SLOs unaffected in soft-fail mode
E2E tests: Simulated tenant traffic with pinned regions exercises both hard and soft modes and snapshot correctness validated
api_contract: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/region-policy -> create or update policy (allowed_regions[], fallback_mode)
Webhooks: subscription events for policy.change, policy.violation, snapshot.ready
ui_notes: Top-level Compliance tab: new 'Locality & Retention' panel
Create flow: select regions (multi-select), choose fallback (Hard: block, Soft: allow+warn), set retention buckets for request_payload, embeddings, and logs
Change history: show who changed policy, old vs new values, and link to snapshots generated around changes
Quick action: 'Generate evidence snapshot' button with date-range picker and preset for 'last 90 days'
Warnings: If tenant selects hard-fail and has active traffic outside allowed regions, surface a pre-commit modal listing recent violations
evidence_workflow: Trigger: manual via UI/API or scheduled weekly exports
Collector: query placement DB, storage TTL metadata, and access logs for the range
Assembler: create manifest, sign with platform key, compress to ZIP, store on signed S3 path
Delivery: return short-lived download URL and webhook event notifying tenant admin
Retention: snapshots retained per tenant export-retention policy (default 1 year)
retention_policies: Default tenant retention: 90 days for request payloads, 365 days for embeddings, 730 days for aggregated logs
Override: tenant can set shorter retention per bucket; platform enforces minimums by label
Enforcement: retention config is pushed to storage controllers that set lifecycle rules and purge markers
Audit trail: every retention change is appended to policy-change-log with actor and timestamp
data_model_implications: Add tenant_region_policy table (tenant_id, allowed_regions[], fallback_mode, created_by, updated_at) and link placement records to policy_version for deterministic audits.
rollout_plan: Beta: opt-in for existing tenants via feature flag; migrate one pilot enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) for feedback
Stage: enable enforcement (soft mode) for all tenants and run telemetry for 2 weeks
GA: enable policy creation in UI and hard-mode enforcement after monitored roll-forward and incident window
Migration: automatically backfill policy_version for placements in the past 30 days for snapshot accuracy
dependencies: ENG-37821 routing-service: tag-based region routing and metadata propagation
ENG-40102 storage-controller: programmatic lifecycle rules API
ENG-42319 audit-logs: high-cardinality access logs export job
SEC-101 security-key-rotation: signing key available for snapshots
Console-UX: design tokens and new panel components
risks: Hard-fail could cause availability incidents if policies misconfigured; need guardrails and pre-flight checks
Snapshot generation at scale could be expensive in I/O; may require batching and throttles
Legal teams may require additional metadata fields in evidence; scope creep risk
Retention changes could conflict with regulatory holds; must integrate with legal-preserve toggle
qa_plan: Unit tests for policy CRUD and enforcement logic
Integration tests simulating region routing with injected placement metadata
E2E test case: create policy -> send traffic from disallowed region -> expect hard 403 or soft header and placement log
Snapshot validation: verify manifest integrity, signature verification, and contents match queries
Load test: snapshot generation for a tenant with 10M placement rows simulated
